newsitem.title: USA: SIPEX files to offer 3 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: SIPEX files to offer 3 mln shares.

text.p: SIPEX Corp said Wednesday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of up to three million shares.
Of the total, the company will sell up to one million shares, and stockholders will sell the rest, the filing said.
After the offering, shares outstanding will total 7,980,846, the filing said.
The company has granted the underwriters an over-allotment option on up to 450,000 additional shares.
The offering will be made through Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, UBS Securities, and Adams, Harkness & Hill Inc.
Company proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, the Billerica, Mass., company said in the filing.
SIPEX designs, manufactures, markets and sells innovative, high-performance, high value-added analog integrated circuits.
